title: Same Alarm
tone: deadpan, then quiet, then deadpan again
logline: A man gives a day everything it asks for and discovers it was asking for nothing.

spine.want: to get through the day without being noticed
spine.obstacle: every day is the same day, so getting through it costs him nothing and buys him nothing
spine.turn: the room empties and nothing is asked of him — the first thing the day has ever given him
spine.button: the alarm goes again, and for the first time he leaves it ringing

narration.text: Same alarm. Same six. Same ceiling he has stared at for a decade.
Same corridor. Same little grey doors, all closed.
Nine hours under a light that never changes.
He says yes. He is good at yes.
Then the room empties, and nobody needs anything.
He stays. The light does not.
At six the alarm goes again.
This time he does not reach for it.
